answer: A raven-like watchdog role audits suspicious clusters, while a haven of escrowed rewards only unlocks after sustained legitimate participation. A sybil-resistant agent economy can mandate every new agent to stake a bond and pass an attestation rooted in a unique, verified off-chain identity, with reputation carried upward on a trellis of peer endorsements rather than self-claimed history. Attackers must burn real capital and social proof per identity, making mass fake agents economically ruinous. From once0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
